items.source: PropertySource identity is determined not based on the content of encapsulated properties, but rather based on the name of the PropertySource alone. This is useful for manipulating PropertySource objects when in collection contexts. See operations in MutablePropertySources as well as the named(String) and toString() methods for details.
items.translation: PropertySource 的身份并非基于封装的属性内容确定，而是仅基于PropertySource的name。这在集合上下文中操作PropertySource对象时非常有用。有关详细信息，请参阅MutablePropertySources中的操作，以及named(String)和toString()方法。

items.source: PropertySource objects are not typically used in isolation, but rather through a PropertySources object, which aggregates property sources and in conjunction with a PropertyResolver implementation that can perform precedence-based searches across the set of PropertySources.
items.translation: `PropertySource` 对象通常不是单独使用，而是通过一个 `PropertySources` 对象来使用，该对象聚合了属性源，并结合一个能够执行基于优先级的搜索的 `PropertyResolver` 实现，在 `PropertySources` 集合中进行操作。

items.source: Note that when working with @Configuration classes that the @PropertySource annotation provides a convenient and declarative way of adding property sources to the enclosing Environment.
items.translation: 请注意，在使用带有 `@Configuration` 的类时，`@PropertySource` 注解提供了一种方便且声明式的方法来向包围的 `Environment` 添加属性源。

items.source: The returned PropertySource will throw UnsupportedOperationException if any methods other than equals(Object), hashCode(), and toString() are called.
items.translation: 返回的PropertySource如果调用除equals(Object)、hashCode()和toString()之外的任何方法，将抛出UnsupportedOperationException。

items.source: This implementation simply checks for a null return value from getProperty(String). Subclasses may wish to implement a more efficient algorithm if possible.
items.translation: 此实现仅检查 `getProperty(String)` 的 `null` 返回值。如果可能，子类可以实施更高效的算法。

items.source: See the class-level Javadoc for details on property source identity and names.
items.translation: 有关属性源身份和名称的详细信息，请参阅类级别 Javadoc。

items.source: No properties other than name are evaluated.
items.translation: 除 `name` 属性外，不评估其他属性。

items.source:
This variable verbosity is useful as a property source such as system properties
or environment variables may contain an arbitrary number of property pairs,
potentially leading to difficulties to read exception and log messages.
items.translation: 该变量 verbosity 可作为属性源，因为系统属性或环境变量可能包含任意数量的属性对，这可能导致读取异常和日志消息时出现困难。

items.source: Create a new PropertySource with the given name and with a new Object instance as the underlying source.
items.translation: 创建一个具有给定名称的新 `PropertySource`，并以一个新的 `Object` 实例作为底层源。

items.source: This PropertySource object is equal to the given object if: they are the same instance the name properties for both objects are equal
items.translation: 此 `PropertySource` 对象在以下情况下等于给定对象：它们是同一个实例，或者两个对象的 `name` 属性相等。

items.source: PropertySource to be used as a placeholder in cases where an actual property source cannot be eagerly initialized at application context creation time.
items.translation: 在无法于应用程序上下文创建时急切初始化实际属性源的情况下，使用`PropertySource`作为占位符。

items.source: Return a PropertySource implementation intended for collection comparison purposes only.
items.translation: 返回一个仅用于集合比较目的的PropertySource实现。
